definitions.explanation: A formal expression meaning 'our country,' used in official speeches, government documents, academic writing, and news reporting to refer to Japan (or the speaker's own country). More formal than {日本|にほん}.

examples.japanese: {我|わ}が{国|くに}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Our country's economy is on a recovery trend.

examples.japanese: {我|わ}が{国|くに}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{少子高齢化|しょうしこうれいか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧な⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: In our country, the declining birthrate and aging population have become a serious problem.

examples.japanese: {我|わ}が{国|くに}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食料|しょくりょう}→食料：03250_shokuryou⟧⟦{自給率|じきゅうりつ}→自給率：17046_jikyuuritsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{先進国|せんしんこく}→先進国：11624_senshinkoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{特|とく}に→特に：01260_tokuni⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧⟦{水準|すいじゅん}→水準：03357_suijun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Our country's food self-sufficiency rate is at a particularly low level even among developed nations.

notes:
REGISTER:
A formal, written expression. Used in government white papers, academic papers, news commentary, and official speeches. Not used in casual conversation, where ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧ or うち would be used instead.

COMMON PATTERNS:
⟦{我|わ}が→我が〜：03971_waga⟧ is an archaic possessive form meaning "my" or "our." It survives in set expressions like {我|わ}が{国|くに}, {我|わ}が{家|いえ}/⟦{我|わ}が{家|や}→我が家：03038_wagaya⟧ (my home), and {我|わ}が{社|しゃ} (our company). In modern Japanese, ⟦{我|わ}が→我が〜：03971_waga⟧ is not productive — it only appears in established compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {我|わ}が{国|くに}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧: our country's economy
- {我|わ}が{国|くに}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧: in our country
- {我|わ}が{国|くに}⟦における→〜における：21802_niokeru⟧: regarding our country (formal)
